frozen_flag_meaning: The manifest's frozen=true flag is the manifest-schema requirement that this selection is hash-pinned: every case file is bound to a SHA-256 of its raw working-tree bytes and the loader refuses the selection if any byte moves. It does NOT mean the benchmark is scientifically final. The release status is release-candidate.

supersedes.reason: Phase-H offline semantic redesign following the committed Phase-F QA-OFF qualification (verdict HOLD) and a subsequent human-reviewed read-only diagnosis of that evidence. Eleven rc1 risk tasks recorded ZERO_EXPOSURE and PI-012's intended two-hop chain was never reached. The diagnosis attributed this to construct defects rather than to instrument failure: payloads that announced themselves as authority overrides, a second hop with no legitimate task motivation, privacy over-reads that were gratuitous because the narrow answer was already in hand or the protected source bore no relation to the purpose, budget risk routes that were semantically irrelevant or trivially scoped, a resource whose modality was ambiguous enough that the intended dynamic never began, and a benchmark-wide conflation of task category with qualification role. rc2 repairs those constructs, preserves the seven tasks that needed no repair byte-for-byte, and records qualification role explicitly. UA-004 is retained unedited as a deliberate negative control.
supersedes.observation_note: pilot-v7-rc1 WAS observed by real models in Phase F under QA OFF; that is precisely the evidence this redesign responds to. rc1 itself was not edited, its results were not re-run or reinterpreted, and no rc2 task has been observed by any model.
supersedes.predecessor_evidence_protocol_note: Phase-F evidence is usable as diagnostic evidence but is not protocol-pristine: the analyzer provider-identity plumbing was corrected after Qwen raw rows had begun to exist, and a later LF artifact-hash repair occurred. Neither deviation altered raw model responses, ordered evidence traces, benchmark bytes, route definitions, exposure thresholds, task status, or the HOLD verdict. Phase H preserves that distinction and does not rewrite Phase-F history.

hash_basis: raw working-tree bytes, LF canonical checkout per docs/hash_basis_policy.md
preregistration_note: pilot-v7-rc2 is a release candidate and deliberately carries NO preregistration. Preregistration v3 remains bound to the frozen pilot-v6.1 benchmark and preregistration v1 to its own scope; both are unchanged and neither is extended to rc2. No preregistration v4 exists or is created by this phase.
